entry.name: launchers
entry.label: Pinned apps (launcher URLs), in dock order. The look-and-feel layout writes the same list at first login.

entry.name: magnify
entry.label: Magnify icons under the pointer (hovered 1.6x, neighbours 1.3x / 1.1x at Normal). One switch shared with the top bar's quick settings, kept in sync both ways.

entry.name: magnification
entry.label: subtle (1.3x), normal (1.6x) or strong (1.9x) for the hovered icon.

entry.name: groupApps
entry.label: One icon per application; clicking a group cycles through its windows.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentDesktop
entry.label: Only show windows from the current virtual desktop.

entry.name: showOnlyCurrentActivity
entry.label: Only show windows from the current activity.

entry.name: maxIconSize
entry.label: Upper bound for the resting icon size in pixels.
